en: Sepia-toned postcard showing the interior courtyard or prayer hall of a grand historical mosque. Numerous men in traditional Middle Eastern dress sit or gather on the floor among rows of decorated columns. The architecture features ornate arches, striped stonework, carved wooden screens, and intricate windows. At the bottom of the image there is a caption identifying the location, and a small printed number at the lower left.
